title: Lock API base contract with tests
description: Add focused tests for frontend proxy URL behavior.
acceptance_criteria: URL resolver returns correct local/proxy bases
findings: Canonical API base resolver tested for local, /upah, port 3001, explicit proxy mode, and env override.

title: Normalize payroll stream and fetch URLs
description: Update raw fetch/SSE call sites to use buildBackendUrl.
acceptance_criteria: Stream and fallback raw-tree URLs resolve under proxy
findings: SSE and fallback raw-tree fetch now use buildBackendUrl while axios services keep relative base behavior.

title: Harden loading and auth UX
description: Add watchdog, one-shot fallback, retry UI, and proxy-safe redirects.
acceptance_criteria: Stalled/failed stream reaches visible state and auth redirects intentionally
findings: SSE idle timeout, incomplete stream errors, one-shot fallback, and retry reload path prevent endless loading.

title: Verify backend proxy route contract
description: Add backend tests for proxy health/API/locked verify/stream reachability.
findings: Proxy backend group exposes health and payroll routes; locked verify route returns valid payload with auth.

title: Harden multi-user performance boundaries
description: Add/verify timing, slow logging, timeout, cache/dedupe, cancellation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Bounded latency/failure behavior with duration/cancel logging
findings: Existing DB timeout/cache behavior retained; stream adds slow/cancel logs and max runtime error boundary.
